# §5 Commerce Analytics — Highlight Candidates

1. **39.8% GMV capture rate masks an 8.5% order capture rate** — the platform handles fewer than 1 in 12 orders but captures nearly 40% of total revenue ($16.8M of $42.2M trailing 12 months), confirming reps selectively use eCat for the highest-value transactions. [→ §commerce]

2. **Quote orders drive 88% of platform GMV at 2.5× the confirmed order value** — 1,397 quotes averaging $10,557 over the trailing 12 months establish the platform as a project-pricing tool, not a routine reorder channel. [→ §commerce]

3. **Top eCat buyers and largest total-business accounts are entirely separate populations** — none of the top 10 platform customers appear among the 30 largest accounts by all-channel revenue, indicating the highest-volume customers have not yet adopted the platform. [→ §commerce]

4. **20 accounts show quarter-over-quarter pricing shifts** — combined current-quarter business of $1.4M across accounts with declining average unit prices warrants individual account-level investigation for competitive pressure or product mix changes. [→ §commerce]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **HIGH**: Activate the largest total-business accounts on the platform — the top all-channel accounts represent over $11M in annual revenue with near-zero platform adoption; even modest activation could add an estimated $2–4M in platform GMV at current capture rates [HYPOTHETICAL]. [→ §commerce]
